notes: Entries of the CD record carry level-numbers 01, 05, 5 (§2002:13.16.31.2 SR3), 10, 88 and 66 (SR2: entries subordinate to a CD take 66, 88 or 1 through 49). The program compiles and every field behaves (all lines); C1-ONE, an 88 under a level-5 entry, prints C1-ONE; the 66 entries RN1/RN2/RN3 print. Ran at --std 2002 (pinned dc1f2dcce8): output equals the derived .out.
